    // The corner of the box farthest along `direction`: each local axis
    // independently takes the sign of the direction's component on it.
    Support(b: OrientedBox2D, direction: Direction2D): Point2D
    {
        var d = LocalOffset(b.Center, b.Rotation, b.Center + direction.Vector);
        var hx = b.Size.Width * 0.5;
        var hy = b.Size.Height * 0.5;
        return b.Center + WorldOffset(b.Rotation,
            Vector2D(d.X >= 0.0 ? hx : -hx, d.Y >= 0.0 ? hy : -hy));
    }
```

    // The vertex farthest along `direction`. Correct because the polygon is convex,
    // so its support point is always a vertex.
    Support(g: RegularPolygon, direction: Direction2D): Point2D
    {
        var vertices = g.RegularPolygonVertices;
        return vertices.Reduce(vertices.First, (best, v) =>
            direction.Vector.Dot(v.PositionVector) > direction.Vector.Dot(best.PositionVector)
                ? v : best);
    }
```

    // The point of the circle farthest along `direction`.
    Support(c: Circle, direction: Direction2D): Point2D
        => c.Center + direction.Vector * c.Radius;

```plato

    // The support of a Minkowski sum is the sum of the supports: the farther
    // endpoint along `direction`, displaced by r along it.
    Support(c: Capsule2D, direction: Direction2D): Point2D
        => (direction.Vector.Dot(c.A.PositionVector) >= direction.Vector.Dot(c.B.PositionVector)
            ? c.A : c.B) + direction.Vector * c.Radius;
```
